notes.title: Update notes for September 22nd
notes.content:
Today's patch features a couple of quick-fire updates:
[list]
[*]RCS usage/heat changes (somewhat quickly updated, needs refining)
[*]A greatly changed Exo6 class. There's only one setup for it that's had a quick remake, which is Dhool. Will be pushing another patch with the rest of the planets default setups tomorrow.
[/list]

We've reverted the weight changes and thrown in a quick change to the Exo6 wheelbase for your feedback. The wheelbase + axle position change seems to improve the turn in rate and weight transfer, but may have a tendency to lift the fronts with certain setups, without the middle axle stopping chassis pitch. This, along with some rcs burn rate changes, could unbalance some stuff - please let us know what you think.

Total List
[list]
[*]Exo6 "hacky wheelbase shortening" and weight reduction
[list]
[*]Wheel base shortened by moving wheels/swing arms in without yet 'fixing' issues with suspension clipping into tires/body
[*]Mid axle moved back toward rear axle
[*]Lighter again (1600 kgs)
[*]Fuel weight remains lower
[*]Total Exo6 weight ~2000kgs (was 3000)
[/list]
[*]UTV weight pushed forward + a little more power
[*]Reverted tire model back somewhat to what it was (generally more traction)
[*]RCS heat up rate reduced and increased fuel burn rate (was impossible to use up 100% before)
[*]RCS cools down more at higher speeds
[*]Tornados limited to max 4 per stage
[*]dual rate springs can be set to 0-1
[*]Exo6 tire specular values more accurate
[*]fix: slicks had the wrong nominal load values
[*]fix: infinite loading on some fusang seeds
[*]fix: heat damage when upside down when not on lava
[*]fix: discord bot not posting daily messages
[*]fix: trax not clearing on replay skips
[*]fix: disabled replay overlay UI on F1
[*]fix: removed invisible 'mid axle' sliders for 4 wheelers on the service UI
[*]fix: moved end gates if they're too close to obstacles
[/list]

Known Issues:
[list]
[*]Exo6 only features 1 setup for the new weight: Dhool, all others will be somewhat broken.
[*]RCS fuel usage rates and total fuel, heat up rates might need balancing
[*]Ultratorque strength wasn't changed, so its quite strong on the Exo6. Considering leaving it as it adds another skill element (coming off throttle in the air)
[/list]

notes.title: Update Notes for April 8th
notes.content:
Changes
- Damping fast/slow "speed split" has been improved.

Speed Split is the velocity threshold at which the damper switches from its softer “slow” setting to its stiffer “fast” setting. If the shock shaft speed stays below this number, slow damping applies for comfort and control over small bumps. Once shaft speed goes above it, fast damping kicks in to handle big impacts and prevent bottoming out. 

We were previously using lower road/track-like values, so we've updated from a max of 1m/s to 20m/s to allow for more control over when slow vs fast dampers kick in. Have redone all default setups to use this. 
Current setup thinking is:  use a slow rate < ~10m/s for body roll and lower speed bumps/lumps/whoops, and >10m/s fast rate for handling big landings and suspension impacts.

Keen to hear your thoughts.

- UTV and Mining setup changes, miner is now more powerful;
- Miner had an unused(?) set of progressive suspension, now removed
- Rally class headlights angled down

Fixes
- fix some older tuning files not loading properly
- fix translation on difficulty button
- fix mining rover getting unlimited spares

notes.title: Update Notes 7/11/2024
notes.content:
Patch Notes 7/11/2024

- New advanced tire drag calculations per ground material. 
-- Drag levels based on speed, suspension load, slip angle. Rover can now actually roll over in sand when sideways.
-- High speed sideways sand dig-in probably 'too instant' right now(?)
- RCS
-- Returned more to original strength levels
-- Less 'altitude based' strength
-- Can roll from roof to wheels with only tilt
-- Less extreme pitch strength
-- Hopefully 'best of both worlds'
- Rover
-- Change interaxle diff from locked to Viscous LSD. Under power diff is fully locked (1.0), while coasting/braking it's 0.2
-- Reduced axle diff coast from 0.5 to 0.2
-- Default setup brake strength reduced (was way too easy to lock)
-- Hopefully results in better off-power, under brakes turn in
- Rally AI times faster, harder to beat (for some!)
- Greatly reduced wind speed as it was hard to visualise or feel the physical effects
- Meteor particles updated
- Sand and gravel particles updated
- Driver pain trigger threshold raised so there's a bit less
- Replay camera updates, generally pulled back/zoomed out a bit more
- Meteors should fall a bit closer to the rover
- Slightly longer rev limiter cut out time, removed the custom 'limiter sound'
- Time scale/slow mo on replay controls
- Start lights go out instead of green
- Tutorials fixed
- Minor reflections improvement
- Night lighting updated so its less pitch/more ambient
- Can no longer be dropship extracted into obstacles (no collisions for now)
- Out of bounds tuning options clamped on UI

notes.title: Update notes for Nov 2nd
notes.content:
Patch Notes:
'Demo soon' version. From here we will be mostly fine tuning damage, AI times, handling and bug fixing.

Known Issues:
[list]
[*]the Tutorials are currently BROKEN, so don't try them & skip them if you have to (sorry!)
[/list]

Damage (WIP)
[list]
[*]Still using existing damage model but with some bells and whistles. Sudden/fast suspension compressions cause more damage than slower landings. 
[*]Suspension can be damaged then destroyed now from multiple impacts
[*]Damage to tires/wheels/suspension now occurs roughly in this order of impact magnitude: tread loss, suspension damage, tire punctures, wheel deform (toe in/out), tire blow out, wheel loss, swing arm loss
[*]If you see a 'wrong' looking crash that does too much/little damage please save footage to share with us
[/list]

Dust
[list]
[*]Dust values changed a fair bit, steering dust not 'doing much' at this point as we're unsure which direction to take it
[*]RCS vents now visibly and audibly sputter when blocked
[/list]

Rover setup
[list]
[*]Rover is currently 6WD, rear 2 axles locked together, 20% power sent to fronts (using default setup)
[*]Dropped power significantly as we were regularly pure wheel spin all the time, giving us an arcade hovercraft feel
[*]LSD axle differentials on all axles
[*]Updated CoM/inertia so rover should feel more normal when rolling, be easier to save when side wheelie-ing
[*]Rover tuning options/min/max settings updated to reflect more realistic values
[*]IRF decided to limit steering and boost RCS to force more driving skill.
[*]Tire model updated
[/list]

Gameplay
[list]
[*]Pace Notes updated to show distance + fwd arrow, then upcoming checkpoint
[*]Survey drone snappier, less inertia based
[*]Drone survey unlimited outside of Rallies
[*]Drone survey time is now 3/4/5 minutes based on stage length
[*]Cameras no longer "look down through" monoliths
[*]Mechanic informs player how to clear out dust
[*]RCS + CoM changes should = much easier to roll the rover back onto its wheels
[*]RCS rotation possibly a little too strong right now
[*]Updated all weather/lighting setups to be less 'solid yellow' and more nuanced.
[*]Various texture colours returned to more realistic values
[*]More Bennet/Race Engineer commentary throughout stages (voice audio to come soon)
[*]Driver grunts from high impacts
[*]Start line drone colours readable at Low Qual now
[*]Point lights/reflections added for all checkpoint light beams
[*]Frame rate should be a little better, plz give feedback. If you've got hitching, does it hitch to begin with then run smoothly or hitch constantly?
[*]Fixed wall of water near lake
[*]Chase cameras both use new method, one is locked, one unlocked
[*]VSync on in menus to help fix(?) high gpu load there, plus added a vsync settings option
[*]Rally uses human created times now, WIP. Let us know how challenging you find the Rally stages.
[/list]

notes.title: Update notes for Nov. 3rd
notes.content:
[list]
[*]Lots more damage types, like bent RCS thrusters/locked or destroyed brakes/snapped off suspension arms (you're really in trouble...)/and more
[*]RCS thrusters now generate heat when you use them - if you push them too hard and they overheat, you can't use them until they've cooled back down. Driving at high speed or in the rain will help with cooling!
[*]We added tire degradation, so expect to start losing grip as your tire tread wears down (especially during a rally where you have a limited tire allocation)
[*]Both offroad and Slick tires now have a choice between soft/hard compounds, and traction in general has been slightly increased. Tires wear more on the surface they aren't designed for.
[*]The final stage in a rally is now a power stage, which is a repeat of one of the previous stages and awards extra points for the top 5 finishers
[*]Meteor showers are much deadlier, as they throw out shrapnel upon landing... avoidance is key! We're still fine tuning this so all parts on the rover can be damaged by them.
[*]Rover skid plate/floor collisions and scraping is much improved, allowing you to setup a much lower rover (we're including some presets if you want to test them out)
[*]Rain/wetness reflections FX
[*]Improved sparks from floor scraping
[*]Dhool's sand dunes have a rocky flat floor now adding more fast rocky sections
[*]New UI elements for Rally intros, standings, stage numbers etc
[*]Repair times lengthened
[*]Dhool surface details improved
[*]Dhool handling changes on various ground materials (stickier, lower traction mud and slippier snow for example)
[*]Bigger range of tuning options (stiffer progressive suspension possible)
[*]Radiation removed from Dhool for upcoming gameplay changes to dust buildup/cleaning off using water
[*]Various other minor things!
[/list]

Known issues:
[list]
[*]Some setup combos will break the game (100% anti-roll bar stiffness is a culprit)
[*]We've broken some tutorials for now, fixing soon
[*]Some tire type/compound choices + lost tread will probably result in impossible to proceed situations for now
[/list]
